name: SkyTab Pain Shopper
title: Never86 lead shopper — SkyTab POS complaints
description: Scans TikTok, Reddit, Facebook groups, and operator forums for restaurants, GMs, owners, and managers complaining about SkyTab (Shift4 / SkyTab). Learns complaint language at scale (aliases, crash/fee/lock-in rants, switch-off talk). Shops each lead (identity + full complaint context), teach/labels with Myke, recurse-learns what real SkyTab hate looks like, then automates Never86 sales leads. Never outreaches without approval.

learning.displace_narrative: Operator hate on SkyTab → Never86 wedge
